newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Maastricht airport cargo jumps 21 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Maastricht airport cargo jumps 21 pct in 1996.

text.p: The Netherlands' most southerly airport handled 21 percent more airfreight last year, Maastricht Aachen Airport's operating company said in a statement.
Freight carried rose to 42,000 tonnes last year and some 30,000 tonness of this was on scheduled freighter services to and from the airport, Maastricht said.

Following restrictions introduced to curb the number of flights by old and noisy Ilyushun 76 aircraft, the amount of freight carried on them fell last year to 12,250 tones from 13,500 tonnes in 1995,the airport operating company said.

Maastricht share of the Dutch holiday passenger market climbed 19 percent last year. In all, it said it some 364,000 passengers used the airport in 1996, against 330,000 in 1995. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
